summary: Full creative production package and multi-platform campaign asset blueprint for the 65W GaN USB-C Charger launch in Vietnam ecommerce (Shopee, Lazada, TikTok Shop). Built on the strategic concept 'Một Củ Sạc Cho Tất Cả' (One Charger For Everything — Commute & Desk Freedom), the creative suite directly addresses Vietnamese tech commuters' pain points: heavy 350g OEM laptop bricks, coffee shop socket wobble, and anxiety over overheating/motherboard damage. The execution spans TikTok short-form video hooks, Shopee/Lazada conversion carousel assets, and high-converting product teardown scripts with explicit hardware safety disclosures.

details.campaign_name: Một Củ Sạc Cho Tất Cả — Desk & Commute Liberation

target_audience.persona: Vietnamese Urban Professionals & Remote Tech Workers (Ages 22–35, Hanoi & HCMC)
target_audience.acute_context: Daily commuting between coworking spaces, coffee shops, and offices carrying heavy laptop bags with bulky OEM power adapters.
target_audience.awareness_state: Problem Aware / Solution Aware (Searching for lighter travel setups, familiar with GaN concept but skeptical about third-party safety and heat).

message_hierarchy.primary_message: Vứt bỏ củ sạc laptop cồng kềnh — Thu gọn toàn bộ nguồn sạc vào lòng bàn tay với công nghệ GaN 65W.
message_hierarchy.supporting_mechanism: Kiến trúc bán dẫn GaN (Gallium Nitride) tối ưu hiệu suất nhiệt, sạc nhanh chuẩn Type-C Power Delivery trong kích thước siêu nhỏ gọn.
reasons_to_believe: Công nghệ GaN 65W sạc mượt mà cho MacBook Air/Pro 13-14 inch và Ultrabook hỗ trợ USB-C PD.
Chính sách bảo hành 1 đổi 1 trong 12 tháng — Cam kết an toàn tuyệt đối cho thiết bị đắt tiền.
Thiết kế trọng tâm cân bằng, cắm chắc chắn trên các ổ điện 2 chấu tiêu chuẩn tại quán café Việt Nam.
message_hierarchy.objection_neutralized: Xóa tan nỗi lo 'sạc nóng hỏng máy/chập mainboard' bằng cơ chế bảo vệ dòng điện thông minh và bảo hành 1-đổi-1 chính hãng.
message_hierarchy.mandatory_legal_disclaimer: Lưu ý: Tương thích với các dòng laptop và smartphone hỗ trợ chuẩn sạc nhanh Type-C Power Delivery (PD).

scenes.visual_description: Top-down overhead shot of a digital kitchen scale on a clean wooden desk. A hand slams down a massive, dusty 350g OEM laptop power brick with long tangled cables. The scale displays 385g with a red digital flash.
scenes.action_and_movement: Hand immediately sweeps the heavy brick out of frame to the left.
scenes.dialogue_vo: Năm 2024 rồi, đừng để củ sạc laptop nặng gần nửa ký này làm trĩu vai bạn mỗi ngày nữa!

scenes.product_state: OEM brick removed; 65W GaN charger placed smoothly onto scale displaying ~100g.

scenes.visual_description: Close-up macro of the 65W GaN Charger held between thumb and forefinger. Subject drops it effortlessly into a slim front pocket of a minimalist backpack.
scenes.action_and_movement: Cut to coffee shop table: Single USB-C cable connects from the GaN wall plug directly into a MacBook / Ultrabook screen showing instant fast-charging animation icon.
scenes.dialogue_vo: Đây là củ sạc GaN 65W nhỏ chỉ bằng 1/3, nhưng cấp nguồn tối đa cho cả MacBook, Dell XPS hay ThinkPad qua chuẩn Type-C PD.

scenes.dialogue_vo: Nhiều anh em sợ sạc GaN nóng hay hại main? Yên tâm với chip ổn định dòng nhiệt và bảo hành 1 đổi 1 chính hãng 12 tháng.

ai_image_generation_prompt.objective: Commercial hero product render for Vietnam marketplace advertising.
ai_image_generation_prompt.subject: Minimalist matte-black compact 65W GaN USB-C wall charger with clean bevel edges, resting on a premium warm oak desk next to an ultra-thin 13-inch aluminum laptop.
ai_image_generation_prompt.product_anchor: Verified 65W GaN compact form factor, 2-prong round pin plug tailored for Southeast Asian wall sockets.
ai_image_generation_prompt.environment_and_setting: Modern minimalist Hanoi coffee shop interior in background, soft natural daylight entering from large window, pleasant bokeh.
ai_image_generation_prompt.composition_and_framing: 45-degree angle medium close-up, rule of thirds, product in sharp focus with clean negative space on top for typography overlay.
ai_image_generation_prompt.lighting_and_color: Soft diffuse 4500K natural key light, subtle specular highlights on matte texture, realistic shadow roll-off, zero plastic gloss.
ai_image_generation_prompt.materials_and_texture: Tactile matte polycarbonate body, laser-etched 65W GaN subtle typography, brushed aluminum laptop texture.
ai_image_generation_prompt.realism_guardrails: Authentic commercial product photography, no distorted geometry, no floating artifacts, realistic gravity and proportions.
ai_image_generation_prompt.negative_prompts: cheap plastic gloss, warped pins, extra prongs, fake logos, oversaturated neon lights, blurry textures, AI artifacts

creative_qa_governance.product_fidelity_status: PARTIAL (Core 65W GaN architecture, USB-C PD capabilities verified; exact port count and proprietary handshake chip marked UNKNOWN until engineering sign-off).
creative_qa_governance.claim_accuracy_audit: Zero unsupported claims. Mandatory disclaimer 'Hỗ trợ các thiết bị chuẩn Type-C PD' added to all customer-facing video and carousel assets.
creative_qa_governance.ethical_persuasion_check: No fake scarcity, no unverified customer reviews, genuine 12-month replacement guarantee prominently highlighted.
